title: Compact policy evaluator and guardrails middleware for API/runtime/console
creator: Maya Patel
description: Deliver a compact, low-latency policy evaluation engine and a small-footprint authorization middleware that can be embedded into API gateways, runtime proxies, and the Redwood Console. The goal is to provide a single evaluation primitive with tenant-aware policy pinning, deterministic audit emission, and a clear path for SSO/SAML admin control enforcement. This ticket implements the evaluator core, middleware adapters (gRPC/HTTP/JS), and the audit envelope format used by downstream pipelines.
acceptance_criteria: Evaluator exposes a stable gRPC and HTTP decision API (check/authorize) with <=1ms median overhead on p50 for cached policies
Middleware adapters for API runtime (Envoy filter prototype), public API gateway (HTTP middleware), and Console (JS shim) that add canonical authz headers and emit audit events
Audit events follow the new immutable audit envelope schema and are forwarded to the audit-forwarder with retry/backoff
Policy pinning per-tenant and per-route is supported and configurable via the Console release page
A deny-by-default fallback path when evaluator is unreachable, configurable per-customer
SAML/SSO admin role assertions are validated and mapped to RBAC v2 roles by the middleware for console and admin APIs
tasks: Design evaluator data model and in-memory index for fast rule lookup
Implement delta policy loader with atomic swap and version tagging
Build gRPC check service with protobuf and input validation
Create HTTP middleware for API gateway with header normalization
Prototype Envoy WASM filter for low-latency runtime enforcement
JS shim for Console that performs lightweight client-side allow checks for UI elements (non-security-critical)
Integrate audit envelope emission and wire to audit-forwarder topic
Add metrics: eval_latency_ms, eval_cache_hit, eval_reject_count, audit_emit_failures
notes: This implementation intentionally focuses on a compact evaluator (small heap/low GC pressure) to allow embedding in Dedicated agent processes. It is not the full policy-authoring UX; authorship and complex policy debugging live in a separate admin service. The middleware must not leak role-to-actor mappings in logs; audit events should only contain role IDs and policy version tags.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Policy churn causing frequent reloads -> Mitigation: delta loader with coalescing window and backoff
Risk: High latency on cold cache -> Mitigation: warmup blob during startup and prefetch for high-traffic tenants
Risk: Mis-mapped SAML assertions -> Mitigation: add strict mapping tests + schema validation and sample assertion fixtures
qa_plan: Unit tests for evaluator rules, integration tests exercising middleware adapters with SAML assertions, chaos test to simulate evaluator downtime and verify deny-by-default behaviour, and e2e test that validates audit envelope reaches the audit-indexer
deployment_plan: Canary deploy evaluator in runtime-1 shard with feature toggle; enable middleware adapters behind a rollout flag per-tenant in Console. Monitor eval_latency_ms and audit_emit_failures during canary; rollback on >5% request error rate or >2x p95 latency.
comments: 2025-10-28 Maya Patel: Created ticket after architecture workshop. Initial design doc attached. Key constraints: sub-ms cold-path, deterministic audit format, support for SAML admin assertions.

2025-10-30 Diego Alvarez: Spike completed. Implemented prototype evaluator in Go using a compact trie for principal/route lookups. Observed p50 eval latency ~0.9ms on c5.large; need to re-run on GPU-hosted agent to account for different GC patterns.

2025-11-01 Design review (Lina Roberts): Suggested adding explainability_id in audit envelope to link back to policy rules for post-hoc debugging. Also requested language around non-leaking of SAML attributes in logs.

2025-11-03 Security review note (Arjun Mehta): Require threat modeling for the HTTP middleware; ensure authorization headers cannot be spoofed by intermediary proxies. Recommending mTLS between gateway and evaluator instances.

2025-11-04 Diego Alvarez: Implemented atomic delta loader (PR referenced). Added initial Envoy WASM prototype and pushed test vectors for SAML mapping. CI green on unit tests; integration tests pending audit-forwarder availability. Planning canary next week.
